ColorChoice.description: When to use color in terminal output.

oneOf.description: Color when writing to a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset.

DurationSpec.description: A duration: a whole number followed by s, m, h, d or w (e.g. "24h").

destructive.description: Destructive tools. Only honored from the user config file (see [`resolve`]).

enabled.description: Whether the MCP server may run.

hash_names.description: Hash project and directory names in results.

redact_home.description: Replace the home prefix with `~` in results.

base.description:
Directory that holds `.scull-quarantine` for items on its volume (replaces lower
layers).

bases.description: Per volume (or directory) → base directory (replaces lower layers).

enabled.description: IDs of optional rules to enable (replaces lower layers).

ScanLayer.description: `[scan]` in a [`ConfigLayer`]. See [`super::ScanConfig`] for the meaning of each field.

exclude.description: Paths never scanned (added to lower layers).

min_tier.description: Minimum tier per path (added to lower layers; the most protective tier wins).

protect.description: Protected paths, always S3 (added to lower layers).

Tier.description:
How much risk removing an item carries.

The ordering is by **protectiveness**: `S0 < S1 < S2 < S3`. Combining evidence always takes
the maximum (the most protective tier), and a tier may only ever move *up* this order after a
scan (invariant I-8: tiers never decrease on revalidation).

oneOf.description:
Regenerable: a verified generated artifact, reproducible from tracked inputs.
Preselected for review, but never executed without confirmation.
Costly to recreate: reproducible, but needs a significant download or build. Opt-in.
Uncertain: ownership, activity or reproducibility is unclear. Never preselected.
Protected: possibly unique data, in active use, or explicitly protected. Never acted on.

description:
One trusted configuration source with every field optional: the user config file, the
environment ([`EnvLayer`]) or CLI flags. `None` means "not set here".

This is also the **user config file format** (TOML). Unknown keys are rejected:

```toml
[scan]
roots = ["~/Projects", "~/work"]
exclude = ["~/Projects/huge-monorepo"]
protect = ["~/Projects/thesis"]
activity_window = "48h"
threads = 0              # 0 = automatic
low_resource = false

[scan.min_tier]
"~/Projects/legacy" = "S2"

[rules]
enabled = ["community.unity-library"]

[mcp]
enabled = true
destructive = false
redact_home = true
hash_names = false
max_results = 1000

[forge]
enabled = false

[output]
color = "auto"           # auto | always | never
units = "binary"         # binary | decimal

[quarantine]             # optional; see `QuarantineConfig`
base = "~/.scull-q"

[quarantine.bases]       # optional, per volume
"/Volumes/Data" = "/Volumes/Data/me/.q"
```
